public_rationale: Both parts hold. OpenAI's launch post said ChatGPT 'sometimes writes plausible-sounding but incorrect or nonsensical answers.' Within a week, The Register reported it giving bad information in biographical sketches, and Stack Overflow banned its answers over high error rates. On bias, The Daily Beast reported that on December 4, 2022, Berkeley researcher Steven Piantadosi documented ChatGPT outputs saying only white males make good scientists, along with other racist outputs. OpenAI also said at launch that the model would sometimes exhibit biased behavior.
limitations: The bias examples came from adversarial prompts reported in the press, not from a systematic audit.
